name: construction-only-ast
setup: class Base { constructor(value) { this.value=value; } } class Derived extends Base { constructor(value) { super(value); } read() { return this.value; } } function bench(n) { if (false) { class Unused {} } let total=0; for (let i=0;i<n;i++) { let LocalBase=Base; let LocalDerived=Derived; total+=new LocalDerived(i).read(); } return total; }
